sloka: उक्त वाक्यम् तु राजानम् कृपया कुशिक आत्मजः ।अब्रवीत् मधुरम् वाक्यम् साक्षात् चण्डालताम् गतम् ॥१-५९-१॥
transliteration: ukta vākyam tu rājānam kṛpayā kuśika ātmajaḥ ।abravīt madhuram vākyam sākṣāt caṇḍālatām gatam ॥1-59-1॥

translations.english: What the king said was proved by his chandala form which the son of Kushika (Viswamitra) heard and out of compassion spoke these sweet words:
